entities.name: Argivia
entities.description: Capital of New Argive, a fortified city ruined in the Phyrexian Invasion and rebuilt.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion that ruined the first Argivia.

entities.name: Godwyn
entities.description: Compleated scholar who led the raid on Argivia and was killed by Kari.

entities.name: Kari
entities.description: Compleated woman who betrayed and killed Godwyn.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Dragon who went to Argivia's ruined library.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: Dragon who went to Argivia's ruined library.

entities.name: Treva
entities.description: Primeval dragon found cemented into the floor and awakened by a ritual.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: Sleeper agent who led the Phyrexians in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Argivia was overrun.

events.summary: Godwyn leads a raid that ruins Argivia, killing its inhabitants and destroying most of its books.
events.quote: Godwyn killed all of the city's inhabitants and destroyed almost all of its books
he was betrayed and killed by the Compleated woman Kari

events.summary: A second Argivia is built on the site during the Rift Era.
